notes.title: Version 1.1 is out!
notes.notes:
Version 1.1 of Follow The Cat is out now!

Here, important points to mention are on below:

-FOV added
-Gameplay precision
-Bugs
-Motion blur removed
-Player character more accurate
-Level improvements


If you encounter any issues, please post on our Steam Forums, where I’ll be tracking bugs and doing my best to issue fixes as soon as possible.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725480/Follow_The_Cat/
